how: The opening invitation supplies a proposer without requiring that other participants joined that particular starter.
Members recruit helpers for an initial character proposal, live repairs and a later addition.
A participant answers a repair call with a bare report of doing a part.
Members propose characters and negotiate colour, kerning, compression and lettering while the design remains open.
Members check the artwork and report it restored or contained within a protective box.
Members request a template, publish a version for an announced move and circulate new coordinates.
Members rally against erasure and prefer maintaining the current work over expansion that exceeds their available hands.
Participants identify a proposed overwrite and correct a later interpretation of another group's intended changes.
An individual offers rebuilding help after the neighbour dispute without establishing a collective apology or completed restoration.
Members report negotiations about incorporation and receive requests to spare neighbouring artwork and recover border tiles peacefully.
A neighbour reports overwritten artwork and a reply justifies covering it, without identifying an initiating attack call.
An announced preemptive move does not establish completed relocation following erasure or overrun.
Members celebrate recognizable survival, praise a small workforce and describe the joint effort as an honour.
Members save a protective picture during building and recount defence, damage and the end afterward.
Pride in survival and detailed recollection establish no decision to continue the collective or reuse its work.
Four-tile placing and correcting a mention bot identify no scripts, spare accounts or automated canvas placement.
A neighbour offers maintenance for restoration and another participant proposes helping nearby defenders against a shared threat.
An alliance offer establishes proposed cooperation without showing reciprocal acceptance or an operating coalition.
An overwrite dispute continues through insults and popularity comparisons before a different participant offers rebuilding help.
Negotiated incorporation would preserve the work inside a larger neighbour's design, but actual hosting and protection remain unresolved.
A participant directs readers to a canvas megathread without establishing moderator enforcement or restrictions on other posts.
Reluctance about a move and refusing another chat account do not explicitly limit representative standing or deny an envoy's authority to make agreements.
After closure a participant corrects the account of intended erasure and the next reply acknowledges attachment to the original version.
Builders move planning into chat and explicitly dispute whether another account is required to propose changes.
Participants ask what a neighbouring logo's name means and receive an explanation before asking about its artist.
A wish for advertising establishes hoped-for discovery rather than observed newcomers, returners or audience growth.
A participant makes a canvas-specific inquisition joke while telling an offended neighbour to maintain its space.
Members consider moving before a stronger neighbour overruns them and announce a compressed hosted version while the existing work remains threatened.
Creating a maintenance channel does not establish a new community formed around the canvas mark.
The record includes insults and objections to overwriting but establishes no exchange policing offensive jokes, slurs or hate symbols.
General advertising hopes identify no appeal to represented creators, teams, companies or the press.
A neighbour challenges covering its logo and a participant defends the overwrite as spreading awareness.
A proposed addition receives personal criticism and its advocate contests the participation requirement, without establishing withdrawal or subsequent reconciliation.
Public planning invitations and diplomatic referrals establish no hidden plans, spying or infiltration of another room.
The calls and megathread pointer provide no instance of members attacking their own work because canvas posts annoy them.
The canvas invitation establishes no host framing of the effort as an April Fools prank.
Members explicitly judge their workforce insufficient for maintaining a larger picture.
The neighbour dispute concerns overwritten artwork and publicity without establishing a quarrel inherited from before the canvas.
Character and shrine proposals establish fandom imagery without establishing an inherited running joke, ideology or collective history shaping the effort.
Participants recount eight hours of repair, regret sleeping and attribute strong emotions to sleep loss.
The reported end supplies the common placement cutoff, while the cited concepts establish no particular glitch or technical workaround.
Helping other groups and discussing diplomacy establish no explicit dual belonging or divided loyalty between neighbours.
Attempts to require prior consultation can constitute disputed order even when formal offices and voting procedures are not visible.
The stated justification for overwriting invokes publicity rather than a prior tie naming the target as a rival.
Members report discussions with a larger neighbour and refer a design proposal to the person handling diplomacy.
The opening proposal cannot be connected to the later build through a documented response or participant attribution.
The proposer is visible but the record cannot connect that starter to the later recruitment and repair effort.
The main effort enters the record already threatened, so the complete original transition from building into upkeep cannot be established.
An upkeep request explicitly refers to simultaneous discussion with the threatening neighbour about the work's future.
A border settlement must be evidenced before it explains restraint, because this repair offer instead accompanies explicit personal reconsideration.
Repeated reversals and manpower limits establish strain without identifying whether machine hands followed it.
Participants explicitly credit a small workforce's maintenance achievement and celebrate the recognizable result.
Recording need not follow celebration because protective screenshots circulate during upkeep before the later achievement account.
Recording survival establishes no subsequent decision to preserve the collective or move the image into another use.
Judged weakness does not establish cessation of resistance when incorporation is announced but later participants still advocate pushing the neighbour back.
Templates and disputed additions are visible, but the record cannot establish that publishing a template settled the shared design.
The repair call receives a direct bare participation report, supporting this local pair without establishing obligations for silent readers.
A maintenance-for-restoration offer is visible without evidence that strained upkeep produced an accepted exchange or delivered assistance.
Proposed reciprocal help and separate negotiations do not establish a border agreement opening a channel that subsequently delivered help.
Recruitment and a justified overwrite coexist without evidence that recruitment produced a call to attack the neighbour.
A rebuilding offer follows an overwrite dispute without an observed attack call and refusal pair.
The overwrite dispute and incorporation negotiation concern different counterparties and cannot establish an attack call producing a truce.
A neighbour names the overwrite and direct answers justify it and contest whose artwork matters.
An alliance proposal during maintenance does not establish that pressure resulted in a coalition defending jointly.
Calls and a later megathread pointer establish neither a flood nor a host rule adopted because of flooding.
The bounded agreement-to-authority-dispute sequence cannot be established through objections to chat access while internal negotiations remain unavailable.
Explaining reversed additions as uninformed repair requires evidence of shared authorization, because explicit design rejection can instead explain resistance to a proposed change.
A neighbour dispute turns toward offering repair through explicit personal reconsideration rather than a demonstrated border settlement or collective apology.
Crediting a proposed contributor occurs during an unfinished addition, including explaining attribution to a mention bot.
A participant explicitly attributes attachment to the original version to repeated patching, preserving the value of maintenance within the retrospective account.
Regret over a missing pixel does not establish cleanup of a shared preserved copy, although a separate correction of the event account is observed.

statement: Wanting publicity without an observed audience return
how: Damaged lettering matters as a lost opportunity for publicity even when no newcomers or growth are observed.
